entities.summary: May Revolution and Independence, a transformative movement in Argentina (1810–1820). Emerged from Congress and May Revolution (Revolución de Mayo) — May 25, 1810. Catalyzed Declaration of independence at Tucumán — July 9, 1816 and San Martín crosses the Andes — January 1817.
